user_exact_text: 你要记住，还是和之前前几轮的流程一样，都是当整改完成之后，我给你所有权限。你帮我整理 github 和本地的仓库，没用的，冗余的部分该删的删，该保留的保留，该合并的合并，然后给我留下干净的 github 和本地仓库并且两者是同步的。
authorization: Conditional final normal merge and recoverable cleanup after all remediation/tagging/final independent gates pass.
required_before_cleanup: All29 required,10 optional,9 batches accepted; final cumulative tagging and independent ultra/default overall review PASS; final source/closure and normal main merge checks complete.
Inventory branch/temp-artifact candidates with exact refs/commit identities, retention/deletion rationale, recovery source and protection status.
Preserve all uncommitted user changes before any mutation. Unknown ownership, unique data or unproven recovery means retain.

Keep formal specifications, roadmap, routing deliverables, necessary historical review evidence and exact traceable source commits. A copied file or textual SHA alone does not preserve Git reachability.

Delete only confirmed redundant branches/artifacts recoverable from kept commits/refs/archives. Check reachability and record recovery references before deleting a branch; no force/history rewrite/protection bypass/irreversible deletion.
After operations verify remote main, retained refs, reviewed source identities and required CI/check results. Provide mergeSHA, cleanup list and evidence for separate local synchronization.

responsibility_split.GitHub_and_cloud_repository: This coordinator after all gates, within authorized recoverable scope.
responsibility_split.user_local_preflight_and_sync: Parent assigns separate local task to preserve user modifications, then synchronize after remote completion.

final_delivery_required_evidence: Merged main SHA and final remote main head
Retained/deleted branch and temporary-artifact inventory with recovery basis
Local task synchronization SHA/status and preserved-change disposition, supplied by parent local task
